detail.longDescription: Interactive model of diesel price I've been working on with my (sightspinner) agent. Takes into account the main (known) factors (Hormuz, Ukraine, etc.) contributing to the current spike as well as possible future scenarios. Set up for periodic updates. To view the model without the article: https://app.sightspinner.ai/share/bMO8oBg7n3hjNdyEVAs0xi2NQ7...
